rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for wagering or betting on an outcome.

example.english: I bet you it’ll rain tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我同你打賭，聽日一定落雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 daa2 dou2 ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this when someone actually places a stake, especially in gambling or on a particular side.

example.english: I bet on the home team in this match.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 coeng4 bo1 lok6 zyu3 maai5 zyu2 deoi6

rows.note: Use this for a confident prediction or emphatic ‘I bet...’ assertion rather than an actual wager.

example.english: I bet he’ll be late today.
example.jyutping: gam2 gong2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when ‘be sure’ means to feel confident that something will happen or can be relied on.

example.english: I bet I’ll pass this time.
example.traditional: 我好有把握今次會考到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jau5 baa2 ak1 gam1 ci3 wui5 haau2 dou2
